_comment: task.formal_verification.013 / 014: every Kani harness of rust/vater_core/src/proofs.rs, its input domain, each
kani::assume with its justification, and the cover statements Kani must report as satisfied. A cover that is
satisfied shows the harness, after its assumptions, still reaches that case, so no assumption empties it.
tests/test_kani_assumptions.py keeps this file and the harness source identical; scripts/check_kani.py fails
the formal-rust CI job unless every harness here is verified and all of its covers are satisfied.

checked_add_matches_the_specification_fo.excluded: Python integers above 2^64 - 1 are outside the port's u64 domain; Python refuses them as OUT_OF_RANGE (tests/test_core.py).

every_unsigned_32_pair_adds_exactly_or_o.input_domain: every pair of u32 values (the whole valid input range)

a_transition_is_allowed_exactly_when_it_.input_domain: every pair of the seven states

assumptions.justification: The two indices name one of the seven states; every other u8 value names no state (State::from_index returns None for it), so the assumption removes no pair of states. The covers show both an allowed and a forbidden pair are reached.

permits_is_the_grant_policy_for_every_gr.input_domain: every grant (64-bit tool and destination sets, revoked or not, any or no deadline), publisher, tool index, optional destination index and clock value
permits_is_the_grant_policy_for_every_gr.excluded: Hosts with more than 64 registered tools or destinations (indices are refused at 64 and above). The clock is an input: a wrong host clock is outside the proof (docs/FORMAL_VERIFICATION.md).

an_approval_admits_only_its_exact_unused.input_domain: every reservation binding, approval binding, use flag, expiry, ledger clock, and a present or absent approval
an_approval_admits_only_its_exact_unused.excluded: Identifiers stand for the strings and the argument digest the ledger compares; that distinct canonical arguments never share a SHA-256 digest is a cryptographic assumption, not proved.
